guidance: Our longer-term guidance, however, remains of 20% growth in the core gases business.
As the plant became operational towards the end of the quarter, we expect to see the beneﬁt of a full quarter of operations beginning in this quarter, that is Q3 of FY27.
capex: As we complete the ﬁrst half of FY27, Ellenbarrie is moving from capacity creation to capacity monetization.
An important milestone during the quarter was the successful commissioning of our new 325 tons per day on-site plant in Durgapur, West Bengal in September 2026.
risks: My question was how much delay is there in the pass- through?
Padam Kumar Agarwala: These have been delayed mainly due to the land allotment by the respective state governments and statutory approvals.
focus: We are now expanding towards northern and central India to access new industrial clusters, diversify our customer base, and create a more balanced pan-India footprint.
We remain focused on disciplined execution, operational eƯiciency, and sustainable growth.
Overall, we enter the second half of FY27 with assets that are progressively moving towards higher utilization.

about: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd. is engaged in the business of oxygen and nitrogen. The Company is a manufacturer and supplier of industrial gases in the eastern and southern India, both in bulk and packaged form. It is engaged in the medical, chemical, construction, defense and energy businesses.
